cond_0001.intro: The Technical Analyst role is an entry-level technical position designed to prepare employees for all potential technical pathways within [Company name masked] by developing strong basic knowledge of [Product name masked] and subsystems and the industrial automation industry. The Technical Analyst participates in a structured training program that includes [Product name masked], in-person training and passing the [Product name masked] Core Certification and Gold test. This role participates in a variety of activities that supports the Technical Support Division, while gaining broad experience with the software, associated technologies and the activities of other departments within [Company name masked].
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Support ticket triaging: collecting information from customers in order to craft effective technical support tickets that can be efficiently handled by Support Engineers; learning to identify, at a high level, different categories of issues and how to prioritize them
Certification test grading: assisting the Training Department in grading certification tests, while learning about different ways tasks are accomplished in the software, and basic troubleshooting skills
Effectively communicating technical issues both internally and externally to customers
Applying knowledge of various technologies including SQL databases, Python, networking, Windows, and Linux
Learning to use virtualization technologies such as docker, AWS and VMWare to simulate complex architectures
Participating in various department initiatives
Participating in and leading peer-to-peer trainings
At later stages in the program, working directly out of the ticket queue and conducts Support ticket research; such as troubleshooting reported issues, identifying and researching potential bugs, and writing effective bug tickets

Taking advanced [Product name masked] classes and passing the Gold certification test
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
In progress with a College Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar experience
Familiarity with Windows, Linux (Ubuntu) and OSX Platforms
Familiarity with programming concepts (Java, Python, similar)
Familiarity with SQL databases (MS SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle, similar)
Experience with SQL languages
Excellent communication & interpersonal skills

This role participates in a variety of activities that supports the Technical Support Division, while gaining broad experience with the software, associated technologies and the activities of other departments within [Company name masked].
cond_0200.responsibilities:
The Technical Analyst's job skills, qualifications, and responsibilities, include but are not limited to:
Support ticket triaging: collecting information from customers in order to craft effective technical support tickets that can be efficiently handled by Support Engineers; learning to identify, at a high level, different categories of issues and how to prioritize them
Certification test grading: assisting the Training Department in grading certification tests, while learning about different ways tasks are accomplished in the software, and basic troubleshooting skills
Effectively communicating technical issues both internally and externally to customers
Applying knowledge of various technologies including SQL databases, Python, networking, Windows, and Linux
Learning to use virtualization technologies such as docker, AWS and VMWare to simulate complex architectures
Participating in various department initiatives
Participating in and leading peer-to-peer trainings
At later stages in the program, working directly out of the ticket queue and conducts Support ticket research; such as troubleshooting reported issues, identifying and researching potential bugs, and writing effective bug tickets
Applying knowledge and utilizes resources available to help with identification and track of customer issues (i.e. Support Channel, User Manual, [Company name masked] Forums, Management)
Taking advanced [Product name masked] classes and passing the Gold certification test
cond_0200.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
In progress with a College Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar experience; advanced degree strongly preferred
Demonstrated expertise with Windows, Linux (Ubuntu) and OSX Platforms
Strong command of programming concepts (Java, Python, similar)
Deep knowledge of SQL databases (MS SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle, similar)
Proven track record with SQL languages
Substantial general networking expertise (routers, switches, subnets, vlan, etc…)
Must pass [Company name masked]'s Core Test within 30 days of employment (within two weeks to completion)
Must pass [Company name masked]'s Gold Test within 60 days of employment (within two weeks to completion)
Preferred Requirements
A broad technical curiosity and proven technical understanding
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills
cond_0200.values: We value work that supports people well and reflects genuine care in how it is done. We believe responsibility and respect matter as much as the end result.

Support ticket triaging: collecting information from customers in order to craft effective technical support tickets that can be efficiently handled by Support Engineers; learning to identify, at a high level, different categories of issues and how to prioritize them
Certification test grading: assisting the Training Department in grading certification tests, while learning about different ways tasks are accomplished in the software, and basic troubleshooting skills
Effectively communicating technical issues both internally and externally to customers
Applying knowledge of various technologies including SQL databases, Python, networking, Windows, and Linux
Learning to use virtualization technologies such as docker, AWS and VMWare to simulate complex architectures
Participating in various department initiatives
Participating in and leading peer-to-peer trainings
At later stages in the program, working directly out of the ticket queue and conducts Support ticket research; such as troubleshooting reported issues, identifying and researching potential bugs, and writing effective bug tickets
Applying knowledge and utilizes resources available to help with identification and track of customer issues (i.e. Support Channel, User Manual, [Company name masked] Forums, Management)
Taking advanced [Product name masked] classes and passing the Gold certification test
cond_0282.requirements:
Currently working toward a College Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Some familiarity with Windows, Linux (Ubuntu) and OSX platforms; you don't need to know all of them deeply
Exposure to programming concepts (Java, Python, or similar); comfort with the basics is a good starting point
Background in SQL databases (MS SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle, or similar)
Some experience with SQL languages
General networking experience (routers, switches, subnets, vlan, etc.); working knowledge is fine
A broad technical curiosity and willingness to keep learning
Ability to communicate effectively and work well with others; openness to feedback is valued

The Technical Analyst participates in a structured training program that includes [Product name masked], in-person training and passing the [Product name masked] Core Certification and Gold test. This role participates in a variety of activities that supports the Technical Support Division, while gaining broad experience with the software, associated technologies and the activities of other departments within [Company name masked].
cond_0488.responsibilities:
The Technical Analyst's job skills, qualifications, and responsibilities, include but are not limited to:
Support ticket triaging: collecting information from customers in order to craft effective technical support tickets that can be efficiently handled by Support Engineers; learning to identify, at a high level, different categories of issues and how to prioritize them
Certification test grading: assisting the Training Department in grading certification tests, while learning about different ways tasks are accomplished in the software, and basic troubleshooting skills
Effectively communicating technical issues both internally and externally to customers
Applying knowledge of various technologies including SQL databases, Python, networking, Windows, and Linux
Learning to use virtualization technologies such as docker, AWS and VMWare to simulate complex architectures
Participating in various department initiatives
Participating in and leading peer-to-peer trainings
At later stages in the program, working directly out of the ticket queue and conducts Support ticket research; such as troubleshooting reported issues, identifying and researching potential bugs, and writing effective bug tickets
Applying knowledge and utilizes resources available to help with identification and track of customer issues (i.e. Support Channel, User Manual, [Company name masked] Forums, Management)
Taking advanced [Product name masked] classes and passing the Gold certification test
cond_0488.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
In progress with a College Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar experience; advanced degree strongly preferred
Demonstrated expertise with Windows, Linux (Ubuntu) and OSX Platforms
Strong command of programming concepts (Java, Python, similar)
Deep knowledge of SQL databases (MS SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle, similar)
Proven track record with SQL languages
Substantial general networking expertise (routers, switches, subnets, vlan, etc…)
Must pass [Company name masked]'s Core Test within 30 days of employment (within two weeks to completion)
Must pass [Company name masked]'s Gold Test within 60 days of employment (within two weeks to completion)
Preferred Requirements
A broad technical curiosity and proven technical understanding
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills

This role participates in a variety of activities that supports the Technical Support Division, while gaining broad experience with the software, associated technologies and the activities of other departments within [Company name masked]. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp how the software and its underlying systems fit together.
cond_0589.responsibilities:
Support ticket triaging: collecting information from customers in order to craft effective technical support tickets that can be efficiently handled by Support Engineers; learning to identify, at a high level, different categories of issues and how to prioritize them
Certification test grading: assisting the Training Department in grading certification tests, while learning about different ways tasks are accomplished in the software, and basic troubleshooting skills
Effectively communicating technical issues both internally and externally to customers
Applying knowledge of various technologies including SQL databases, Python, networking, Windows, and Linux
Learning to use virtualization technologies such as docker, AWS and VMWare to simulate complex architectures
Participating in various department initiatives
Participating in and leading peer-to-peer trainings
At later stages in the program, working directly out of the ticket queue and conducts Support ticket research; such as troubleshooting reported issues, identifying and researching potential bugs, and writing effective bug tickets
Applying knowledge and utilizes resources available to help with identification and track of customer issues (i.e. Support Channel, User Manual, [Company name masked] Forums, Management)
Taking advanced [Product name masked] classes and passing the Gold certification test
cond_0589.requirements:
In progress with a College Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar experience
Familiarity with Windows, Linux (Ubuntu) and OSX Platforms
Familiarity with programming concepts (Java, Python, similar)
Familiarity with SQL databases (MS SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle, similar)
Experience with SQL languages
General networking experience (routers, switches, subnets, vlan, etc…)
A broad technical curiosity and proven technical understanding
Excellent communication & interpersonal skills
Employee must pass [Company name masked]'s Core Test within 30 days of employment (within two weeks to completion)
Employee must pass [Company name masked]'s Gold Test within 60 days of employment (within two weeks to completion)
